title: string - display title
subtitle: string - one-line hook

unplug_activity.title: string - activity name
unplug_activity.teacher_prompt: string - what the guide says to prompt reflection
unplug_activity.aha_moment: string - the insight the student should have

misconceptions.description: string - what the student wrongly believes
misconceptions.detection_pattern: string - code pattern or answer that reveals this

parsons_problems.title: string
lines: string - code lines in random order
distractors: string - extra lines that don't belong

questions.line: number - line number to ask about
questions.question: string - what is the value of X here?

write_exercises.title: string
write_exercises.starter_code: string - partial code with blanks or TODOs
misconception_checks: string - misconception IDs to watch for

patterns: string - Striver pattern slugs this supports

canonical_lesson_slug: string - optional: reuse an existing canonical lesson instead of custom ThinkInCode phases
